<h1 align="center">Security Policy</h1>

## Supported Versions

Security updates are provided for the latest released version of maarg.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| Latest release | Yes |
| Older releases | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a potential security vulnerability in maarg, please report it privately rather than opening a public GitHub issue.

You can report security vulnerabilities through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature, if enabled for this repository.

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce the issue.
- The potential impact.
- Any relevant logs or proof-of-concept details.

## What to Expect

- Your report will be reviewed as soon as reasonably possible.
- The maintainer may contact you for additional information.
- Confirmed vulnerabilities will be assessed and addressed based on their severity.
- Public disclosure should be coordinated with the maintainer to give users an opportunity to update.

Thank you for helping keep maarg and its users safe.
